title: Local Muse Spark: LiteLLM provider contract, not a one-off Meta complete() wrapper
description:
## What shipped in the lp-k5c4.13 local QA loop (not product)

To stop empty harness turns after switching off Grok, the local LA wrapper `/tmp/lp-k5c4.13-serve-la.mjs` was given a **one-off** `metaComplete()`:

- POST `https://api.meta.ai/v1/chat/completions` with `reasoning_effort: "minimal"`
- Bypasses `@lanyard-agent/providers` `LiteLlmClient.complete()`
- Needed because `LITELLM_BASE_URL=https://api.meta.ai/v1` plus client path `/v1/chat/completions` hit **`/v1/v1/chat/completions` 404**, so turns completed with zero events

This is **not** a Portal/BFF gateway. It is a QA harness adapter. Do not treat it as the Meta Model API product path.

## Correct contract

`LiteLlmClient` already POSTs `{baseUrl}/v1/chat/completions`. For Meta Model API:

- `LITELLM_BASE_URL=https://api.meta.ai` (no trailing `/v1`)
- `LITELLM_API_KEY` = Meta key
- `HARNESS_MODEL=muse-spark-1.2-contributor`
- Optional: `reasoning_effort` as a first-class completion field on the provider client, not a forked fetch

Keep keys in `~/.lanyard-agent/meta.env` (mode 600), not `meta.env.example`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Local harness uses `createEnvLiteLlmTurnRunner` / LiteLLM client only (delete `metaComplete` wrapper)
- [ ] Documented env: base `https://api.meta.ai`, not `.../v1`
- [ ] One turn `message_send` with non-empty content against Muse Spark
- [ ] No Meta-specific fetch in Portal BFF
acceptance_criteria: Delete serve-la.mjs metaComplete. LITELLM_BASE_URL=https://api.meta.ai (no /v1). Non-empty message_send on Muse Spark. No Meta fetch in Portal BFF.
close_reason: Done. Squash-merged https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/719. Muse Spark via LiteLLM provider contract; no metaComplete wrapper.
